scope: One V25h boot_a-only trial on exact Lynx CPH2493 slot A. V25h keeps V25g's exact stock kernel and init; only the local Wi-Fi supervisor gains a best-effort discovery beacon. abort_conditions: Unexpected Fastboot identity or slot, candidate or stock hash mismatch, write error, warm phone, USB connected during native boot, no authenticated SSH/health proof within the bounded window, unexpected recovery or reboot.
